trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and the platinum pops on its own. Nothing else to do — this one is the receipt, not a task.

steps.t: Finish the other 54 trophies in any order; the platinum unlocks the moment the last one lands.
No online play and no DLC is needed — all 55 are in the base single-player game.
The full set is worth 1,350 PSN points: bronze 15, silver 30, gold 90, platinum 300.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Finish the opening mission Gone Fishing and it pops.

steps.t: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, to the end.
Cannot be missed — it unlocks the first time the mission ends.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Finish Chapter 1; it pops as Chapter 2 begins.

steps.t: Complete every main mission of Chapter 1.
The trophy pops at the chapter turn — PowerPyx notes chapter trophies can pop at the start of the next chapter.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Finish Chapter 2; it pops as Chapter 3 begins.

steps.t: Complete every main mission of Chapter 2.
Pops at the chapter turn, like the other chapter trophies.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Finish Chapter 3; it pops as Chapter 4 begins.

steps.t: Complete every main mission of Chapter 3.
Pops at the chapter turn, like the other chapter trophies.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Finish Chapter 4; it pops as the finale begins.

steps.t: Complete every main mission of Chapter 4.
PowerPyx puts the chapter end at the final Chapter 4 mission, Starting From Zero.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Finish the final mission and the gold pops. Keep a manual save from just before it — there is no mission replay.

steps.t: Play the final mission to the end.
Keep a save from before the final mission; the game has no mission replay and no New Game Plus.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Complete the Chapter 2 mission Breakfast Run.

steps.t: Reach and finish Breakfast Run in Chapter 2.
Story trophies cannot be missed — keep playing the main missions.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Complete the Chapter 3 mission The Cartel Heist.

steps.t: Reach and finish The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3.
Story trophies cannot be missed — keep playing the main missions.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Complete the Chapter 4 mission Child's Play.

steps.t: Reach and finish Child's Play in Chapter 4.
Story trophies cannot be missed — keep playing the main missions.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Complete the Chapter 4 mission Headliners.

steps.t: Reach and finish Headliners in Chapter 4.
Story trophies cannot be missed — keep playing the main missions.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Complete the Chapter 4 mission VCIA Takedown.

steps.t: Reach and finish VCIA Takedown in Chapter 4.
Story trophies cannot be missed — keep playing the main missions.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Complete the Chapter 5 mission Operation Savage Glory.

steps.t: Reach and finish Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 5.
Story trophies cannot be missed — keep playing the main missions.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion on the in-game checklist. The checklist is far more forgiving than true 100%: most activities need only part of their total, and side quests mostly do not count at all.

steps.t: Finish the story first — the checklist only appears under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion after the credits, but earlier progress already counts.
Clear the robberies: 39 of 39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs, 7 payday loan jobs, 8 of 8 bank vaults.
Clear the collectibles that matter: 15 of 18 card sets, 100 WAiNK scans, 33 underwater discoveries, 15 of 18 meditations, 200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals.
Clear the activities: 42 of 42 shooting-range golds, 42 of 42 drone time trials, 300 of 397 stunts, 70 of 80 challenges, 15 of 15 target decks.
Do any 100 optional missions — there are 200 to 300 in the game, so the count fills itself.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts. Mix the four kinds and pick the quickest — flying under bridges is the fastest.

steps.t: Do any 250 stunts across the four kinds: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights, 25 base jumps.
Under-the-bridge flights are the quickest to rack up — pick them first.
Track progress by region under Progress, Activities, Stunts, and on the map under Exploration, Stunt Spots.
The 100% checklist needs 300, so keep going past 250 if you want A Long Road too.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. Most happen on their own while you play; check the list under Progress, Activities.

steps.t: Do one of each of the 9 types: Fishing, Hunting, Golf, Shooting Ranges, Pool, Basketball, Playing a Video Game, winning a car race / race challenge / Top Fun drone race, and performing a stunt.
View the list under Touchpad, Progress, Activities — scrolling over a type shows how many you have done.
Filter the map for Activities (blue dumbbell icon) to find the ones you have not tried.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. The medals are the only hard part — the ranges themselves are quick.

steps.t: Earn gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the ranges.
PowerPyx lists 12 range locations; OutputLog counts two shooting ranges with 42 golds between them — the medal count agrees, so follow the in-game range list, not the location count.
Gold medals are also needed for the 100% checklist (42 of 42), so this is not optional for the platinum.

trophies.disagree: PowerPyx lists 12 shooting range locations; OutputLog says two shooting ranges hold the 42 gold medals between them. Both agree on 42 golds — follow the in-game list.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every one of the 14 locations. One win per location is enough.

steps.t: Win at least one drone race at each of the 14 Top Fun locations — 42 races run across them.
The 100% checklist needs all 42 drone time trials, so keep racing past the 14 wins.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Any 20 of the 40 unique race locations count.

steps.t: Win 20 different races across the 40 unique race locations.
The 100% checklist needs 30 of 40 races won, so keep racing past 20.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Cal's questline starts in Chapter 1 after the mission Feng Shui.

steps.t: After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui (Meet Cal), wait for Cal's text marking a fishing spot with a purple icon.
Follow Cal's fishing questline until the challenge against him unlocks, then beat him.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game. Four in-game video games count; finish all levels of any one of them.

steps.t: Play any of the 4 video games: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind, or Bang For Your Buck.
The first three play on the TV at home from Chapter 1; Bang For Your Buck is on arcade machines around the world.
Finish all levels of the game once — beating every challenge is not needed.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Lucia-only questline in Chapter 3 — 5 quests in Belville.

steps.t: In Chapter 3 as Lucia, take Andy's call; she texts her address in Belville and the questline marks on the map.
Complete all 5 Andy quests: Climbing the Cellerichain (parts 1 to 3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label, Puff Puff Pass.
The quests stay available after the story — nothing here is missable.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Treasure-diving questline from Chapter 1 — 7 shipwrecks in total.

steps.t: In Chapter 1, after the mission Island Dreams (Work for Kenton), take his call; he is marked by the green KR icon in Key Lento.
Dive the shipwrecks he marks (purple chest icons), dig the treasure up with the metal detector, and bring it back.
Clear all 7 shipwrecks across his repeat calls; track it under Progress, Characters, Kenton Rees.
Kenton goes quiet after Chapter 1 and returns in Chapters 2 to 3 as Jason — he is not missable. Calling Brian as Jason in Chapter 2 speeds his return.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. 5 quests from the Thrillbilly Mud Club in Kelly County.

steps.t: After the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, the questline marks at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County.
Complete all 5 Billy quests: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler, Hometown Heroes.
All quests stay available after the story.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Only certain questlines count — Andy, Billy, Tyrone, Moses, Yasmani and Eddie do NOT count toward this one.

steps.t: Finish 8 qualifying strands. Confirmed counters: Kirk (Skunk Ape), Kyle (McKittrick Farm), Yago (street racing), Pilot Pete (deliveries).
WATCH: Yago's race against him in Chapter 3 carries an hourglass icon — it is timed. Save first, then race the moment it appears.
Check the counter after each strand in the trophy list — only qualifying strands move it.
Every strand stays available in free-roam after the story.

trophies.missableNote: Yago's timed race (Chapter 3, hourglass icon) is the only timed step — save before it. The strands themselves stay available after the story.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Steal the 16 sports cars on Randy's wish list.

steps.t: After the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS (steal the Zorrusso for Randy), the Key Cloner unlocks and Randy hands over his wish list of 16 sports cars.
Scan high-end sports cars with the WAiNK app to check them against the list, then drive each one back to his garage (green RK icon, west Vice City).
Deliver in good condition for more pay; cars show up often around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach, parked or driving.
Track the list under Map, Robberies, Randy's Wish List. Still doable after the story.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Jason-only: shut down the synthetic labs in Vice City.

steps.t: After the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty, play as Jason and follow the purple markers to the synthetic labs in Vice City.
Destroy enough labs in the quest Take Out Kitty Litter.
Tyrone then gives the second quest, Spin On This — shut the labs down to finish.
Still available after the story.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida. 18 meditations across 10 locations — and one of them can only be done in Chapter 1, so do it first.

steps.t: CHAPTER 1 ONLY: the morning after the mission Down to Earth, find Lucia in the kitchen at Jason's house; follow her to the balcony and accept the meditation.
Keep a manual save from the start of Chapter 1 until this trophy pops — there is no mission replay.
Meditate at all 18 spots across 10 locations; meditating with both leads at a spot counts twice.
The last spots need both leads playable together (after Coffee Break in Chapter 2).
Track the counter under Progress, Collections, Exploration, Meditations — the counter is the truth when the guides disagree.

trophies.missableNote: The Chapter 1 balcony meditation vanishes when Chapter 1 ends. Do it the morning after Down to Earth, and keep a Chapter 1 save until the trophy pops.
trophies.disagree: Is the balcony meditation required? PowerPyx: it adds +1 to the counter but is not marked as a spot, so it is unclear if the trophy needs it. OutputLog: it counts toward the trophy and disappears after Chapter 1. KeenGamer: 18 spots are required and 15 of 18 is enough for 100%. Both versions shown: do it in Chapter 1 either way. How many? PowerPyx: 18 spots across 10 locations, +2 per spot with both leads. The 100% checklist stops at 15.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Jason-only hunting questline from Chapter 2 — 15 target decks.

steps.t: After the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, play as Jason and take Bret Vogel's text; meet him in Lummox County (Veteran Hunted).
Hunt the animals Bret requests and bring them to him; he marks hunting spots with purple icons.
Bret gives you the hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69 — pick it up from any Ammu-Nation weapon locker. One clean shot keeps the carcass pristine and pays more.
Track the 15 target decks under Map, Activities, Target Deck. All 15 are needed for the 100% checklist too.
Which exact animal pops the trophy is still unconfirmed — work the questline and it will come.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. There are 18 set locations in the world; any 3 complete sets count.

steps.t: Collect cards until 3 full sets are complete — 18 set locations exist, so pick the easiest routes.
The 100% checklist needs 15 of 18 sets, so keep collecting past 3.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Scan landmarks, curiosities and sculptures with the phone app — there are far more than 100.

steps.t: Hold Up then R1 to scan with the WAiNK app at landmarks (31), curiosities (35) and sculptures (23).
Any 100 scans count — scan everything you pass while playing.
The 100% checklist also needs 100 WAiNK scans, so this pops on the way to A Long Road.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. There are 80 — pick the easiest 50 and leave the rest.

steps.t: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges; track them under Progress, Challenges.
The 100% checklist needs 70 of 80, so keep going past 50 if you want the platinum.
Most complete on their own while you work on other trophies — leave this for late cleanup and pick the quickest ones left.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Easiest through the train tunnel north of Ambrosia — or let the bank-vault jobs do it for you.

steps.t: Play with your partner beside you: call them with hold Right + Triangle (after Coffee Break in Chapter 2, when both leads play together).
Raise a 4-star wanted level, then escape the red heat zone — leaving the flashing search area is not enough.
Easiest route: a fast sports motorcycle through the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County; the helicopter cannot follow.
Free version: the Chapter 4 bank-vault jobs always trigger 4-star wanted levels, so this pops on its own while robbing vaults.

trophies.disagree: When the two leads play together: OutputLog puts character switching right after Breakfast Run in Chapter 2; PowerPyx puts free-roam together after Coffee Break. Both are Chapter 2 — either way, this trophy opens in Chapter 2.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Keep the stars flashing the whole time — if they fade, the chain breaks.

steps.t: Call your partner (hold Right + Triangle) after Coffee Break in Chapter 2.
Rob 3 robbery targets (green map icons) in a row while the police chase you — keep the red/blue flashing wanted level, not the red heat level.
Bring an armored vest, sticky bombs and healing (Zombix/Adrenaline) from Ammu-Nation.
The pop is delayed about 30 seconds after leaving the third shop — wait before hitting a fourth. Good spot: the 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City (after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs).

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Just scan traffic with the WAiNK app — you do not need to drive them.

steps.t: Open the WAiNK app (hold Up) and scan vehicles with R1; stand on a busy road and scan everything passing.
Scanning is enough — driving is not needed. Check totals under Touchpad, Progress, Vehicles.
The 100% checklist needs 200 of 277 base models, so keep scanning past 100.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Buff your focus first, line the targets up, and do not miss.

steps.t: Activate Combat Focus with L3 + R3 while aiming — it slows time and marks weak spots, and drains the purple focus bar.
Buff focus first with food, drinks or a wash/shower at home, and take Adrenaline (hold L1, Triangle) to extend it.
Line up 5 enemies — gang-operation guards are ideal — and drop them in one use with an assault rifle like the Duke 556.
It does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians. Focus has 4 levels; it rises from shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots, so this gets easier late.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Steal a passenger plane that is docked at a boarding bridge — the ones parked on the airfield do not count.

steps.t: At Vice City International Airport, take a large passenger plane docked at a departure terminal boarding bridge — gates E3/E4 are the easiest.
Go upstairs into the cockpit, drive the plane backward to the airstrip and take off.
Fly about 1 km (0.6 miles) away from the airport — the pop is delayed until then.
Save first: the police come fast. Going through the terminal on foot works too, but the airfield route is quicker.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank at Mile Zero Air Station and use it in combat.

steps.t: Go to Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County.
The tanks stand in the south of the base — drive through the gate or take the stunt jump by the south-east entrance.
Get in a tank and shoot enemies until the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Get the Snap Gun first, go in the back door, and leave no trace.

steps.t: Finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs — it unlocks the Snap Gun and jewelry store robberies.
Pick a store (green icon) and use the Snap Gun on the locked back door — kicking it in sets off the alarm.
In the back room, find the note with the safe code, loot the safe, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm.
Leave without being seen; the trophy pops shortly after you leave. Good target: Richardson Jewelry and Diamonds, Vice City.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Tail a security van to a bank, slip in while the vault is open, and get out on a fast bike.

steps.t: Finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe) — it teaches the first vault robbery.
Tail a security van until it stops at a bank; when the guard carries the briefcase in and the vault opens, go in fast and rob it.
Bring your partner — you cannot carry all the cash alone (hold Right to hand off a bag).
Pay Yasmani $10,000 for security-van tips (after his earlier quests, including 2 Payday Loans) to mark vans with a purple icon.
Robbing a vault gives a 4-star wanted level instantly — escape on a fast motorcycle, then switch cars to break recognition. 5 vaults for this trophy, all 8 for the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. The bank-vault jobs count — or stop a truck on the street with a sticky bomb.

steps.t: Easiest: rob a large bank vault (see Maximum Withdrawal) — it counts as robbing an armored truck.
Earlier method: block an armored truck driving near banks in Vice City, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it open.
Escape the red heat radius (or use a Pay 'n' Spray) — the trophy only pops once you are clear.
Sticky bombs sit in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. Unfog the whole map — a plane does it fastest.

steps.t: Fly over every black-fogged area until the whole map is visible.
A plane is the fastest way to cover the map; work county by county.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. One per gang is enough for the trophy; all 39 for the 100% checklist.

steps.t: Rob 1 illegal operation from each of the 9 gangs — 39 operations exist in total.
They show as yellow icons when you go near them; many mark automatically from story progress.
Track per-gang counts under Progress, Gangs.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. PowerPyx names the spot and the drink; KeenGamer still lists the trigger as unconfirmed — try the named method, it is the best lead anyone has.

steps.t: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach.
Buy an Apple Martini and drink it standing next to the bar.
KeenGamer lists the exact trigger as still being confirmed — if it does not pop, it is the method that is wrong, not you.

trophies.missableNote: Trigger unconfirmed — the method below is the best published lead, not a settled fact.
trophies.disagree: PowerPyx gives a method (Ocean View Rooftop Bar, Apple Martini); KeenGamer lists the exact trigger as still being confirmed. Shown as unconfirmed with the best available method.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. The blue Banshee in the south Vice City showroom, taken with the Key Cloner — KeenGamer still lists the method as unconfirmed.

steps.t: First get the Key Cloner from the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS.
Go to the vehicle showroom in the south of Vice City and take the blue Banshee.
Hack the car, drive forward and straight through the showroom window; the pop is slightly delayed.
Only this blue Banshee counts — a reference to the Banshee from GTA III. KeenGamer lists the exact method as still unconfirmed.

trophies.missableNote: Method unconfirmed — the steps below are the best published lead, not a settled fact.
trophies.disagree: PowerPyx gives a method (blue Banshee, south Vice City showroom, after the Key Cloner); KeenGamer lists the exact method as still unconfirmed.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn — and it is not missable, the robbery respawns.

steps.t: During the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling, the alley marks on the map; buy sticky bombs at Ammu-Nation first.

Steal the 3 key valuables: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the north-east table, and the safe in the north-east hallway office (blow it with sticky bombs).
The trophy pops after you escape the police — killing enemies is not needed.
Not missable: if you miss an item, wait for the robbery icon to respawn and go back for the rest.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. Reach maximum Strength with BOTH Jason and Lucia at the same time.

steps.t: After Coffee Break in Chapter 2, when you can switch between both characters, start training.
Buy a gym membership and work out — always bring your partner (hold Right + Triangle); while one trains, the other completes training too.
Check Strength under Touchpad, Jason and Lucia, scroll to Strength (heart icon). Filter fitness clubs on Map, Activities.
You can also work out at home after the story.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile. It fills itself while you play — robberies and fights all count.

steps.t: Do anything that moves your Criminal Profile: robberies, fights, stealthy objectives, clean escapes. View the count by clicking the trophy in the trophy list.
Turn on profile notifications in Settings, UI, HUD Notifications, Criminal Profile = On — a demon face appears on the right of the screen when an action counts.

Profiles run Professional (stealth, clean escapes), Hardened (incapacitate, do not kill), Violent (killing), Psycho (mass killing, driving over gravestones) and Irredeemable (permanent, excessive violence).
It comes naturally with the other trophies. If it is last, farm it by running over civilians and cops with a car — but cops shoot on sight at Psycho or Irredeemable.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. Nobody has confirmed the trigger yet — the current belief ties it to the Payday Loans store from the prologue.

steps.t: PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, believed to be related to the Payday Loans store from the prologue.
KeenGamer lists the unlock method as unconfirmed.
Do not grind blindly: check the sources again after more players report in, and keep your saves — a trigger found later may need a fresh attempt.

trophies.missableNote: Trigger unknown — do not grind blindly. The belief is the Payday Loans store from the prologue.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? Complete the UFO easter egg north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County — at night, after 2AM, alone. The spawn is random, so it may take a few tries.

steps.t: Go alone to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County, at night after 2AM.
Look for a blinking car at the roadside — it only sometimes spawns. If it is not there, drive away and come back.
Follow the path into the woods from the car to find the UFO (bright blue light in the sky).
Approach it: the UFO drops the woman it abducted. Talk to her, offer to help, and go back to her car at the roadside.
KeenGamer still lists this trophy's method as unconfirmed — the steps above are PowerPyx's account, the only full one published.

trophies.missableNote: Method unconfirmed and the spawn is random — expect a few tries.
trophies.disagree: KeenGamer lists the unlock method as unconfirmed; PowerPyx gives the full UFO easter-egg method above. Shown as unconfirmed with the best available method.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. The current belief is kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle — but no source has confirmed it.

steps.t: PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, believed to be from kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle.
KeenGamer: perform the required melee drive-by elimination; the precise method is still being confirmed.
Do not grind blindly — try the motorcycle-kick belief, and re-check the sources as confirmations land.

trophies.missableNote: Method unconfirmed — the belief is kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. It counts across all robberies — never in one trip.

steps.t: Finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew) to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer for laundering marked bills.
Rob banks and Payday Loans, then bring the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most.
Deliver $250,000 in total; it adds up across robberies. Bank vaults alone pay up to $205,000 in one job (after Chapter 4, That's Where The Money Is…).

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest — they cost the most.

steps.t: Spend $100,000 in total across any shops — the total is cumulative.

Fastest: guns, car mods and tattoos. Shops include 14 mod shops, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 24 Ammu-Nations, 67 clothing stores, 17 footwear, 18 hair and beauty salons, 11 tattoo studios and 15 electronics stores.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. 8 purchasable garages for $160,000 total, bought through the Vice City Real Estate app.

steps.t: After the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver (Steal the Crawler for Moses), the Vice City Real Estate app installs on your phone.
Buy all 8 purchasable garages through the app — $160,000 in total. The 4 story garages do not count.
Robberies are the quick way to the money, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3 to 4.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Buy garages first — each one adds the parking spots you need.

steps.t: After the Chapter 2 mission Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses), the Scooter Bros app installs on your phone.
Drive a stolen vehicle to Moses in Port Gellhorn, choose Respray then Register in his garage.

Each garage adds parking spots, so buy garages first (see Little Boxes). At first Moses only takes vehicles without trackers; from Chapter 3 you can also register standard-tracker cars at any Pay 'n' Spray.
Registering costs money — use cheap low-end cars and bikes.
